stem.en: An object of mass m sits at rest in a laboratory. What does special relativity say about its energy?
stem.et: Massiga m keha seisab laboris paigal. Mida ütleb erirelatiivsusteooria selle energia kohta?

label.en: It has a rest energy mc², whether or not it ever moves or takes part in a reaction
label.et: Sellel on seisuenergia mc², olenemata sellest, kas see kunagi liigub või mõnes reaktsioonis osaleb

label.en: It has none, because rest energy is released only in nuclear reactions
label.et: Sellel ei ole energiat, sest seisuenergia vabaneb ainult tuumareaktsioonides

label.en: It has only kinetic energy ½mv², which is zero while it is at rest
label.et: Sellel on ainult kineetiline energia ½mv², mis on paigalseisu ajal null

label.en: It has unlimited energy, since a fast enough frame would give it any speed above c
label.et: Sellel on piiramatu energia, sest piisavalt kiires taustsüsteemis saaks sellele anda mistahes kiiruse üle c
